body:
Upstream issue: https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/32572

Mirror issue: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/issues/2384

Candidate parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2274 at exact commit `b53a21a7e9c3ca61f35a09eef878ee8bb9a194d6`

Independent review parent PR: https://github.com/amdpilot-org/sglang/pull/2348

## What changed

- Reproduced the review counterexample on the exact candidate: selected `visual.merger.linear_fc1` and `visual.merger.linear_fc2` modules had no layer ID, so `LoRAManager.init_lora_modules` wrapped and registered neither one.
- Preserved the candidate's valid Qwen3-VL deep-stack indexing, Qwen3-VL/MOSS-VL dimension handling, target normalization, and namespace-boundary fixes.
- Added a model-aware logical LoRA layer resolver. MOSS-VL maps only its single unindexed visual merger's `linear_fc1`/`linear_fc2` paths to logical layer 0.
- Applied the resolver consistently to base-module wrapping, adapter tensor placement, and UNO target validation.
- Added regressions for both wrapping/registration and adapter-weight placement, plus retained raw failing-before/passing-after evidence under `reports/j-5560de7d12f5/`.

## Failing before / passing after

Exact candidate `b53a21a7`:

```text
layer_ids {'visual.merger.linear_fc1': None, 'visual.merger.linear_fc2': None}
wrapped []
registered [{}, {}, {}, {}]
Exit: 1
```

Corrected focused suite:

```bash
/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-5560de7d12f5/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \
  test/registered/unit/lora/test_qwen3_vl_lora_targets.py \
  test/registered/unit/lora/test_moss_vl_lora_targets.py \
  test/registered/unit/lora/test_laguna_hidden_dim_unit.py
```

Result: `26 passed`. All applicable pre-commit hooks passed.

A BF16 rank-32 numerical fixture for Qwen3-VL and MOSS-VL merger dimensions also ran on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (`gfx950`) and matched CPU FP32 references.

## Limitations

Qwen3-VL-8B/EditScore and MOSS-VL model/adapter weights were unavailable, so I did not claim a full server/model-load or semantic multimodal reproduction. The available GPU was ROCm gfx950 rather than the report's H100/CUDA platform. The GPU fixture validates projection shapes and arithmetic only. No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
